title: Open when the day feels heavy
description: For the days when even small things feel like they weigh more than usual.
content:
Hey.

I know today is a lot. I don't know exactly what kind of heavy it is — the quiet kind, or the loud kind, or the kind that sits on your chest without a name. But I know it's real, and I want you to know I'm sitting with you in it even when I'm not there.

You don't have to be okay right now. You don't have to explain it or fix it or smile through it. You're allowed to just feel it, all of it, without rushing to the other side.

But I also want you to remember this: you have gotten through every single hard day so far. Every one. That's not nothing. That's everything.

When you're ready — not before — drink some water. Eat something small. And know that tomorrow exists, and it will be softer than today.

I love you. That part doesn't change.

— Manji ♡

title: Open when you miss me
description: A small reminder that distance cannot make the good parts disappear.
content:
Oh, so you miss me? Good. I miss you too.

Distance is such a weird thing. It makes everything feel further than it is. But here's what I keep coming back to: the things we've shared are not somewhere else. They're in you. All of them — every laugh, every stupid conversation at 2am, every moment we looked at each other and didn't need words.

You carry all of that with you wherever you go. And I carry you.

So even on the days when it feels like too much space between us, remember that I'm still here, just in a different timezone. Still thinking about you. Still rooting for you. Still yours.

Miss me a little. But don't be sad about it too long, okay? Save the sad for when you need it and give the rest of the day something sweeter.

Always close, no matter how far.

— Manji ♡

title: Open when you are angry at me
description: Do not open this to skip the feeling. Open it when you are ready to feel it safely.
content:
Okay. So you're angry at me.

First: that's okay. You're allowed to be angry. You don't have to shrink it or apologize for it or pretend it's something smaller than it is. Be as angry as you actually are.

I'm not writing this to defend myself or talk you out of what you're feeling. I'm writing it because I want you to know that even when we're in the middle of something hard, you matter to me. That part doesn't pause.

I know I'm not perfect. I know I get things wrong. And if I hurt you — really hurt you — I want to hear about it. Not because I have to, but because you deserve to be heard by the people who love you, especially when it's messy.

When the anger settles a little, I'll be here. Not to win, not to explain it away. Just to listen, and to try.

Still yours, even now.

— Manji ♡

title: Open on your birthday
description: A pocket-sized celebration for the girl who makes the world sweeter.
content:
Happy Birthday, Wajeeha.

I've been thinking about what to say, and everything I write feels too small. Not because the words aren't there, but because what I feel for you is bigger than what words usually hold.

So here is what I'll say:

Thank you for being exactly who you are. Thank you for the way you laugh. Thank you for caring as deeply as you do. Thank you for letting me be part of your world, even a little.

This year, I hope you get softness. I hope you get mornings where you wake up and feel okay before you even have a reason to. I hope you get the kind of joy that sneaks up on you — the small, quiet, unexpected kind that doesn't need a big occasion.

You deserve every good thing. Not because you earned it or because you were perfect, but just because you exist, and that is enough.

Happy birthday, my favorite person. ♡

With all of my heart,
— Manji
